# opensearch_action_group (Resource)

Provides an OpenSearch security action group resource. Action groups are reusable sets of permissions that can be referenced from roles. Please refer to the OpenSearch Access Control documentation for details.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action_group_name` (String) The name of the security action group.
- `allowed_actions` (Set of String) A list of allowed actions.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the action group.
- `type` (String) The type of the action group, either `cluster`, `index` or `kibana`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
